A saved way of looking at one list — a segment. It holds the filters, free-text search, sort and column choice, and its `filters` use exactly the `?<field>[<op>]=<value>` grammar the list endpoints take, so a stored view and a live API call say the same thing. Scoped to an `entity` (which list) and, for all but the two org-wide lists, a business. `visibility` decides who SEES a view; only its owner may ever change one, and `duplicate` is how you make a colleague's shared view yours.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/list_views`](/help/developers/api-reference/list-views/list-saved-views-for-one-list) | List saved views for one list |
| `POST` | [`/v1/list_views`](/help/developers/api-reference/list-views/save-a-view) | Save a view |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/list_views/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/list-views/edit-a-saved-view) | Edit a saved view |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/list_views/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/list-views/delete-a-saved-view) | Delete a saved view |
| `POST` | [`/v1/list_views/{id}/duplicate`](/help/developers/api-reference/list-views/duplicate-a-saved-view) | Duplicate a saved view |
